status: prospective external-source discovery contract frozen before any new vertical outcomes
role: independent-data extension after closure of the Movebank/archive programme; cannot modify v0.3.8 unless separately reopened after external validation

search_universe.excluded_universe: all Movebank Data Repository parent/legacy bat packages already closed under BAT_PANEL_SEARCH_CLOSEOUT.md
included_repositories: institutional repositories with direct public raw event files
search_universe.data_type: public individual-level movement tracks with timestamps and x-y positions

outcome_blind_allowed_reads: presence/missingness of a native event-level vertical field as a string
prohibited_before_admission: any statistic derived from vertical magnitudes

structural_gate.native_vertical_axis: same-event native vertical coordinate must be present in the public raw track table; externally joined DEM height alone does not qualify
structural_gate.session_definition: split each individual into nocturnal/frozen sessions using source-appropriate calendar-night/session identifiers without reading numeric height
structural_gate.repeat_definition: at least two eligible >=50-fix sessions per individual
structural_gate.raw_event_requirement: event-level timestamped tracks; nightly maxima, foraging-point summaries, or roost-only summaries do not qualify

source_independence.rule: A candidate must be a genuinely distinct source package and tracking programme, not a repackaging of an existing six-source dataset.

decision_rule.pass: Freeze source URL/DOI, file identity/checksum, taxon, schema and structural counts before reading numeric vertical values. Only then may a new validation contract be created.
decision_rule.fail: Record the structural reason and do not inspect numeric vertical outcomes.
decision_rule.no_pass: Close the external search at the frozen cutoff rather than weakening the gate.

stop_rule: Do not lower >=8-individual, >=5-repeat-individual, >=50-fix-session, or native-vertical requirements after candidate inspection.
Do not add a repository or search query because a candidate fails.
Do not select candidates using known vertical behavior from their papers beyond the binary fact that a native vertical field exists.
If no source passes, the next step is new field data or a later prospectively reopened search with a new calendar cutoff.
